title: Cyrus and the Colony
author: Beatrix Brightwater
blurb: Vesper Lockridge, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
